title: Call me next month, and the rep promises approval
scenario: Gloria went quiet after a pre-qualification call. She tells the rep to call back next month and worries about her credit; the rep makes an approval promise to try to keep her engaged.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Gloria, this is Brent with Copperleaf Home Loans. We talked a few weeks ago about buying a place closer to your daughter?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, yes, hello Brent. I'm sorry I didn't call you back.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No worries at all. How's your daughter doing?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: She's good, she just had the baby, so I've been over there a lot. That's my first grandson.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thank you. He's perfect. Doesn't sleep, but perfect.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, that's the deal with babies. So, are you still thinking about moving out there?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I am, but honestly, can you just call me next month? Things are a lot right now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I understand. Can I ask, is it mostly timing, or is something else making you hesitate?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Well, my credit took a hit last year when I had some medical bills. I'm worried I'm not going to qualify. Do you think I'd still get approved?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Don't worry about that at all, Gloria. You'll definitely qualify, I do these all day.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Really? Oh, well, that's a relief.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah. So we could get the application going this week.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'd still want to wait until things settle down with the baby.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sure. Would the first week of next month or the second week be better for me to call?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: The second week. Maybe a Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Tuesday the second week it is. I'll put it in my calendar.
